title: NETSCOUT to Report First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on August 6th
summary: NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC. (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of enterprise network observability, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and Distributed-Denial-of-Service (DDoS) protection solutions, plans to announce its first quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026, on Thursday, August 6, 2026, at approximately 7:30 a.m. ET. NETSCOUT will host a corresponding conference call and live webcast on the same day at 8:30 a.m. ET. The number for the conference call is (800) 267-6316, or (203) 518-9783 for international callers. The conference call ID is NTCTQ127. A replay of the call will be available after 12:00 p.m. ET on August 6 th for approximately one week. The number for the replay is (800) 839-3734, or (402) 220-2976 for international callers.
